name: hivemind-plugins
description: Clickt's HiveMind plugins for Claude Code — one marketplace bundling the marketing deliverables (Google Ads, Meta, and Shopify CRO account audits, the CM3 per-product contribution-margin report, the wPPC weighted-profit-per-click report, and the Google Ads management suite) and the workflow plugins (decision memos, project coordinator, orchestrator, social media manager, daily morning briefing, and catch-up) — most running on Linear, Gmail, and Google Calendar.

plugins.name: google-ads-audit
plugins.description: Full Google Ads account audit driven by the Google Ads MCP (GAQL). Scores live data against a comprehensive 9-step audit framework plus modern Google checks (PMax, Consent Mode v2, Enhanced Conversions, Demand Gen) and emits a 3-format deliverable bundle from one findings JSON: an interactive, self-contained, white-label HTML report (the primary deliverable, with a live Health-Score gauge and ICE re-ranking), an Obsidian-ready markdown record, and a formula-driven multi-tab xlsx backup. HTML + markdown are standard-library only; the xlsx backup needs openpyxl.

plugins.name: meta-ads-audit
plugins.description: Full Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad-account audit via the Meta Ads MCP or manual Ads Manager CSV exports, scored against a comprehensive 7-lever account-audit framework with a deterministic pre-scorer that machine-scores the mechanical checks. Emits a 3-format deliverable bundle from one findings payload — an Obsidian-ready markdown record, an interactive self-contained HTML report (the primary client-shareable deliverable), and a formula-driven xlsx backup — plus Concentration (HHI/Gini/Pareto-ABC) and Creative Signals (fatigue, reach saturation, effective frequency, ranking decomposition) analytics computed straight from the raw data files. Python stdlib only; openpyxl (>=3.1) needed only for the xlsx backup.

plugins.name: shopify-cro-audit
plugins.description: Conversion-rate-optimization audit for a Shopify store, following an 11-step CRO audit framework (analytics, LIFT heuristics, review mining, customer support, heatmaps, surveys, user testing, marketing-match, competitor analysis). Pulls live data through the Shopify MCP (ShopifyQL) and/or GA4 + Shopify CSV exports — the two paths combine — with the entire Step-1 analytics block machine-computed, never hand-transcribed. Emits a 3-format deliverable bundle: an interactive self-contained HTML report (primary deliverable, live 0-150 Funnel Health gauge, (Impact x2)+Ease re-ranking), an Obsidian-ready markdown record, and a formula-driven xlsx backup — plus Concentration (HHI/Gini/Pareto-ABC) and CVR Signals (Wilson CIs, z-tests, empirical-Bayes page CVRs) analytics computed straight from the raw data files. Missing-data steps are declared 'Not run', never fabricated. openpyxl (>=3.1) needed only for the xlsx.

plugins.name: cm3-profitability
plugins.description: Per-product CM3 contribution-margin report from a Google Ads 'Shopping products' CSV (optionally enriched with a Shopify 'Gross profit by product' CSV). One compute pass emits the locked 3-format bundle: an Obsidian-ready markdown report with static SVG charts, a self-contained interactive HTML explorer (tune cost assumptions and band cutoffs; every KPI, band, chart, rollup and product row re-computes live — it carries every workbook tab: By Campaign / Vendor / Category L1-L5 / Product Type L1-L5, plus by-band, summary KPIs and methodology, a live Pivot cross-tab of any two dimensions, and a dark mode), and a detailed multi-tab xlsx; a 7-slide executive pptx is opt-in. Segments products into 5 CM3 bands and rolls up by campaign, category, product type, and vendor. Requires openpyxl, python-pptx, and vl-convert-python.

plugins.name: google-ads-management
plugins.description: Ongoing, cadence-based Google Ads management as done-with-you advisors — dual input (read-only Google Ads MCP or a user CSV export), fronted by an interactive in-Claude menu: invoke 'manage Google Ads' to open the google-ads hub, which lists every task and routes to it. A shared foundation (account selection, GAQL cookbook, 2026 benchmarks, dual-input + advisor output contract) plus account health & red flags, budget pacing, bidding strategy, keywords/search terms, Quality Score forensics, audience targeting, conversions & tracking, performance reporting, competitive analysis, PMax campaigns, PMax listing groups, and product performance. Diagnoses account data against thresholds behind a transcription firewall, then leads a prioritized recommendation loop and offers ready-to-apply Google Ads Editor CSVs — emitting the md + interactive-HTML + tunable-xlsx bundle (or a reduced md + xlsx bundle for account health & audience targeting), with Node<->Python kernel parity across every tunable skill. HTML + markdown are standard-library only; the xlsx backup needs openpyxl and the static chart SVGs need vl-convert-python.

plugins.name: memo
plugins.description: Turn a raw idea into a decision memo a director can act on in one read. Asked to "write this up for the directors", agents reliably produce a fluent memo full of [X hours] placeholders and invented specifics — plans, phases, benchmarks the teammate never said — delivered under their name. This inverts the order: the interrogation is the product, the memo is the receipt. Gates prose behind questioning, scales depth to stakes (a meeting-time change gets three questions; a budget-committing build gets the full treatment), marks every claim measured/estimated/assumed/derived with derived figures inheriting their weakest input, and runs a nine-test adversarial battery — including one aimed at the drafter's own arithmetic — before recommending anything. Emits a single markdown memo: the ask first, real options including doing nothing, a reasoned recommendation, and an honest account of what would kill it.

plugins.name: project-coordinator
plugins.description: Project coordination pipeline for software and marketing projects (content, social calendars, events, launches): refine ideas into briefs, plan work into Linear, structure project folders, and keep Linear as the source of truth with issues executable as standalone Claude prompts. Runs on the Linear MCP.

plugins.name: social-media-manager
plugins.description: Plans a batch of social posts end-to-end: asks how many posts, at what cadence, for which platforms and formats; scans Reddit and news sites for trending content ideas; interviews you to capture your real opinions and direct quotes (building a persistent voice profile stored at ~/.claude/social-media-manager/, outside the plugin); then authors a production-ready writing prompt and a Higgsfield media prompt per post and files each as a scheduled Linear issue. Runs on the Linear MCP + web access.

plugins.name: morning-briefing
plugins.description: Daily Morning Briefing: summarizes Gmail conversations and drafts replies, reports Linear project progress and blocked issues, prioritizes your assigned issues, blocks focused work time on your calendar, and looks three weeks ahead for time-off bottlenecks. Runs on the Gmail, Linear, and Google Calendar MCPs.

plugins.name: wppc-report
plugins.description: wPPC — Weighted Profit-Per-Click. Sabermetric linear-weights report for Google & Meta Ads segment exports: funnel events credited at expected CM3 value, indexed to the account baseline, shrunk for sample size, and scored above replacement (Margin Above Replacement). Emits a 3-format bundle from one model — an interactive, self-contained, white-label HTML report (primary; Scale/Cut/Watch decision lens + four charts), an Obsidian-ready markdown record, and a formula-driven multi-tab xlsx backup (Report/Weights/Charts/Run). Requires pandas, pyyaml, click, openpyxl, and vl-convert-python for the static chart SVGs.

plugins.name: catch-up
plugins.description: Turns everything new since the last run into tracked work: reads call transcripts and email, extracts the tasks, decisions, and open questions, de-dupes them against your tracker, files issues (review-first by default, so nothing lands without your say-so), and drafts both the replies you owe and the follow-ups you need to send — drafting only, never sending. Tool-agnostic: a setup skill binds the call-transcript, email, and project-tracker categories to whatever you connect (Granola/Teams/Meet/Zoom, Gmail/Outlook, Linear/ClickUp/Asana/Jira), saving your choices to ~/.catch-up/config.json and the last-run timestamp to ~/.catch-up/state.json so no call or email is ever processed twice.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Multi-agent project orchestration for Linear-governed repos: round-based execution with tiered executors in git worktrees, a mixed-tier merge gate (8 finder angles, one batched verifier, optional fix-applier), reflect passes against acceptance criteria, checkpoint/halt discipline, interactive review-queue closeout (/orchestrator:close-issues), an interactive learnings loop (/orchestrator:lessons-review), and a checkout-guard hook that keeps the live tree on the base branch. Execution-side counterpart to project-coordinator. Runs on the Linear MCP.
